title: Exercise cross-platform profile adoption
description:
A thin black-box acceptance suite proves that the independently tested package, transaction, command, documentation, and portable-workflow seams compose into the supported adopter journey.

## Background

This final proof consumes public surfaces only. Product defects found here return to their owning leaves or separately tracked bugs rather than expanding this task into a catch-all implementation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: On Unix and Windows, fresh and existing Git-free repositories produce equivalent final state through init delegation and direct apply, including dry-run/no-op behavior and platform-specific executable semantics.
- [hard] REQ-02: One offline black-box journey applies the embedded profile, creates and approves a planning bracket, validates managed prose/projections and portable checker warnings, and reaches implementation-ready breakdown without a source checkout or `jq`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The suite consumes only public CLI/schema/MCP surfaces and asserts that no deferred lifecycle command or field is exposed; unit, property, failure-injection, and component contract tests remain exclusively in their owning leaves.

## Scope

**Blast radius:** new black-box fixtures and platform CI invocation only. Any product defect discovered is returned to its owning leaf (or a separately tracked bug) rather than fixed opportunistically in this acceptance task.

**Green landing:** The bounded cross-platform adopter journey passes over already-green components without duplicating their internal test matrices.
